menu_sections: Create your Own Krazy Fries Box!

Meal Deal.name: Krazy Fries Meal Deal
Meal Deal.description: Any Loaded Fries, x6 Classic Churros and a drink!. Upgrade to  Milkshake for £3.00.

Krazy Fries.name: Garlic Chicken Loaded fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly Cooked  Skin-on Fries,  freshly cooked Crispy chicken cooked and cut into pieces, Garlic butter and our signature Lemon Pepper dry rub

Krazy Fries.name: Nashville Chicken loaded fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly Cooked  Skin-on Fries, Fried Chicken Chunks Fried in Nashville Spices, Gherkins and Chipotle Sauce

Krazy Fries.name: Philadelphia Cheesesteak Fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly cooked Skin-on Fries, topped with Thinly Sliced Rib Eye Steak chunks sauteed  with onions and peppers, Cheesy Sauce and Smokey BBQ Sauce

Krazy Fries.name: Peri Peri Chicken Loaded Fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly cooked Peri Peri Skin-on Fries, Chargrilled Chicken, Choose your Flavour, Lemon & Herb, Mild or Hot, Garlic Mayonnaise.

Krazy Fries.name: NYC Buffalo Chicken Fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly cooked Skin-on Fries, freshly cooked Crispy Buffalo Chicken, Chipotle Mayo, Buffalo Sauce.

Krazy Fries.name: Mango Habanero Krazy Fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly cooked  Skin-on Fries, freshly cooked Crispy chicken cooked and cut into pieces and tossed in our Mango habanero Sauce.

Krazy Fries.name: Lebanese Chicken Loaded Fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly cooked  Skin-on Fries, with Lebanese Chicken, Lebanese Pickles, Garlic Mayo.

Krazy Fries.name: Krazy Cheeseburger Loaded Fries
Krazy Fries.description: Freshly cooked  Skin-on Fries, Double Cheeseburgers chunks, Cheesy Sauce, Ketchup.

Tenders.name: Crispy Chicken Tenders
Tenders.description: Fresh Golden Fried chicken Tenders, 100% chicken breast, fried to perfection and tossed in our specially made sauces, to give the Wings Flavour of Your Choice! Comes with one Dip of your choice

Create your Own Krazy Fries Box!.name: Create Your Own Krazy Fries!
Create your Own Krazy Fries Box!.description: Create your own fries with any sauce and your favourite protein!

Premium Hot Dog.name: Crispy Onion Dog
Premium Hot Dog.description: Single Beef Jumbo Hot Dog, Tomato, Gherkins, Fried Onion Rings, Cheesy sauce and Smokey BBQ Sauce in premium artisan brioche bun.

Premium Hot Dog.name: Chicago Loaded Dog
Premium Hot Dog.description: Single Beef Jumbo Hot Dog with French Fries in the Bun, Red Onions, Gherkins, Ketchup and Mayonnaise in premium artisan brioche bun.

Premium Hot Dog.name: Vegas Hot Dog
Premium Hot Dog.description: Single Beef Jumbo Hot Dog, Caramelised Onions, Ketchup and Mustard in premium artisan brioche bun.

Premium Hot Dog.name: New York Original Hot Dog
Premium Hot Dog.description: Single Beef Jumbo Hot Dog, Red Onions, Gherkins, Tomatoes, Ketchup and Mustard in premium artisan brioche bun.

Premium Hot Dog.name: Mac n Cheese Dog
Premium Hot Dog.description: Single Beef Jumbo Hot Dog, Crispy Mac n Cheese pieces,  Grated Melted Cheese, Lettuce and topped with Chipotle Sauce in premium artisan brioche bun.

Premium Hot Dog.name: Chipotle Dog
Premium Hot Dog.description: Single Beef Jumbo Hot Dog, Fried Onions Rings,  Grated Melted Cheese, and Chipotle Sauce in premium artisan brioche bun.

Milkshakes.name: Mango Magic Milkshake
Milkshakes.description: Our secret recipe of Mango, vanilla soft ice cream and touch of milk blended together!

Milkshakes.name: Create your Thick Shake
Milkshakes.description: Create Your Own Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, Add your Favourite Chocolate, Cake, Cookie Dough, or All! We’ll add a Dash of Milk and Blend them Together for that Thick Creamy Texture.

Milkshakes.name: Crushed Oreo Milkshake
Milkshakes.description: Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, Real Oreo Biscuits, dash of Milk and Blended Together for that Thick Creamy Texture.

Milkshakes.name: Chunky Peanut Butter
Milkshakes.description: Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, A Big Spoon of Real Chunky Peanut Butter, Dash of Milk and Blended Together for that Thick Creamy Texture.

Milkshakes.name: Cookie Dough Milkshake
Milkshakes.description: Our oven baked cookie dough pieces of white, milk and double chocolate cookie dough blended with soft vanilla ice cream and a touch of milk!

Milkshakes.name: Biscoff Milkshake
Milkshakes.description: Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, Biscoff Biscuits, Dash of Milk and Blended Together for that Thick Creamy Texture.

Milkshakes.name: Kinder My Shake
Milkshakes.description: Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, Kinder Chocolate Bar, dash of Milk and Blended Together for that Thick Creamy Texture. Choose from Milk Chocolate Kinder or White Chocolate Kinder from the options.

Milkshakes.name: The Rocher Shake
Milkshakes.description: Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, Ferrero Rocher Chocolate, dash of Milk and Blended Together for that Thick Creamy Texture.

Milkshakes.name: Strawberry Delight
Milkshakes.description: Thick Milk Shake made using real Ice Cream, Real Strawberries, dash of Milk and Blended Together for that Thick Creamy Texture.

Waffles.name: American Legend Waffle
Waffles.description: Milk Chocolate Sauce, Ferrero Rocher Chocolate pieces served with soft vanilla ice cream

Waffles.name: Classic Oreo Crumble Waffle
Waffles.description: Oreo crumbled, white chocolate sauce, Milk chocolate sauce served with soft vanilla ice cream

Waffles.name: French Toast Waffle
Waffles.description: Covered with cinnamon sugar and Caramel Sauce, served with soft vanilla ice cream

Waffles.name: Kinder Bueno Bliss Waffle
Waffles.description: White chocolate & Milk Chocolate sauce with White Kinder Bueno chocolate bar served with soft vanilla ice cream

Waffles.name: Lotus Crumble Waffle
Waffles.description: Biscoff crumble with White chocolate sauce served with soft vanilla ice cream

Waffles.name: New York Classic Waffle
Waffles.description: Fresh strawberries, Milk chocolate sauce, served with vanilla soft ice cream

Desserts.name: Classic Churros
Desserts.description: Freshly Fried Churros (6 pieces), tossed in our own Cinnamon & Sugar mix for extra delicious crunchiness. A true Classic!

Desserts.name: Red Velvet Cake
Desserts.description: A Slice of Pure Indulgence, luxurious red velvet slice topped with white chocolate sauce.

Desserts.name: Churros with Milk Chocolate Drizzle
Desserts.description: Freshly Fried Churros (6 pieces), drizzled with Milk Chocolate Sauce to finish it off.

Desserts.name: Churros with white chocolate drizzle
Desserts.description: Freshly Fried Churros (6 pieces), drizzled with White Chocolate Sauce to finish it off.

Desserts.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
Desserts.description: Glorious cake with layers of chocolate indulgence, topped with chocolate sauce.
